qstat_path.description: Full path to the PBS qstat command used to query job status.

qsub_path.description: Full path to the PBS qsub command used to submit jobs.

qdel_path.description: Full path to the PBS qdel command used to delete jobs.

qacct_path.description: Optional full path to PBS qacct command for accounting logs.

qhost_path.description: Optional full path to PBS qhost command for node status.

qrun_path.description: Optional full path to PBS qrun command for immediate job execution (e.g., Moab/Torque).

max_jobs_per_query.description: Maximum number of jobs to query in a single PBS qstat call. Lower values reduce memory load on the scheduler.

poll_interval.description: Seconds between polling PBS for job status updates. Shorter intervals improve responsiveness but increase load.

verbose.description: If enabled, logs detailed PBS interaction debug messages.

allowed_queues.description: List of PBS queue names that users may submit jobs to.

default_queue.description: PBS queue used when a user does not specify one during job submission.

default_resources.description: Default resource request string applied to jobs missing explicit resource specs (PBS Torque/Moab format).

prolog_path.description: Optional absolute path to a PBS prolog script executed before each job starts.

epilog_path.description: Optional absolute path to a PBS epilog script executed after each job completes.

env_vars.description: List of environment variable names (without values) to preserve and pass to the job environment via SEG.

items.description: Name of environment variable to preserve (e.g., 'MYAPP_CONFIG').

attr_mappings.description: Custom mappings between PBS attributes and Globus job attributes. Useful for exposing scheduler-specific data.

name.description: Unique identifier for this mapping (used only in config to disambiguate).

globus_attr.description: Globus job attribute name to expose (e.g., 'walltime_seconds').
